subject: GWAS by subtraction error when subtracting multiple traits

messages.author: 6091a278f5723483
messages.subject: GWAS by subtraction error when subtracting multiple traits
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to run a GWAS-by-subtraction to subtract ascending (AscAoD) and descending (DesAoD) aortic diameter from thoracic aortic aneurysm and dissection (TAAD) to see if I can identify the latent “dissection” trait separate from the ascending thoracic aneurysm (ATAA) and descending thoracic aneurysm (DTAA) latent traits. I have arranged my code per advice I could find in previous conversations using the Cholesky method. Here is my code:

 

model<-'ATAA=~NA*AscAoD + AscAoD + DesAoD + TAAD

      DTAA=~NA*DesAoD + DesAoD + TAAD

      DIS=~NA*TAAD + TAAD

 

      ATAA~SNP

      DTAA~SNP

      DIS~SNP

 

      ATAA~~1*ATAA

      DTAA~~1*DTAA

      DIS~~1*DIS

      ATAA~~0*DTAA

      ATAA~~0*DIS

      DTAA~~0*DIS

 

      AscAoD~~0*AscAoD

      AscAoD~~0*DesAoD

      AscAoD~~0*TAAD

      DesAoD~~0*DesAoD

      DesAoD~~0*TAAD

      TAAD~~0*TAAD

      SNP~SNP'

 

When I run this, however, I receive the following message: 

 

Error in .userGWAS_main(i, int, n_phenotypes, n, I_LD, V_LD, S_LD, std.lv,  : 

  task 1 failed - "Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular: U[4,4] = 0"

Calls: <Anonymous> -> %dopar% -> <Anonymous>

Execution halted

 

In reading what is available, it seems like this could be because I have betas = 1 in my TAAD sumstats (given it is binary), but I don’t and none of my betas = 0. I was wondering if you had any thoughts about what I am doing wrong here. 


Thanks for the help!


Jack
